label: PROCESS-BLINDED DIAGNOSTIC AFTER INVESTIGATOR PLP EXPOSURE
scope: Conditional observation of pitched activity given frozen Bass/BP hypothesis. No source proof, no physical onset accuracy claim. No stem audio, model, historical selections or PLP given to inference.
targets: Every exact member pitch at its native onset; also frozen fundamental pitch at each member onset if different. Preserve all63 frozen families/98members and ambiguity. Never merge or bridge windows.

method.name: local complex-demodulated Hann energy
method.Hann: symmetric odd-length kernel N=2*round(2*sr/f)+1, normalized sum; coefficient amplitude 2*abs(sum(window*x*exp(-i2pi*f*t))); target power=maximum amplitude squared over three tuning channels
method.frame_centers: original recording sample multiples of44; centered signal support outside observation allowed solely for filtering, no outside-window onset search
method.resolution: finite support N/sr; exact equivalent-noise bandwidth sr*sum(w*w)/sum(w)^2; Hann main-lobe first-null width approximately ±2sr/(N-1) around each tuning center. Tuning range is not total effective passband. Centered smoothing can precede an abrupt physical start by up to half support; no correction.

observation_rule.candidate: When armed by observed power<=low, save first subsequent frame >low. Confirm only if power then reaches>=high and remains>=high for at least one target period. Emit saved existing low-crossing frame; rearm only after <=low. No extension beyond BP window; incomplete rise unresolved. No generic spectral peaks.
observation_rule.initial_high: No inferred onset before window; await low state. Continuous if observable but dynamic ratio<4 or begins above low with no complete new rise and no incomplete rise.
observation_rule.not_observable: peak<energy_floor or median(target power)/(4*median(centered Hann full-mix power))<.01; proxy criterion not proof of absent target.
observation_rule.unresolved: Observable dynamic activity but no confirmed rise and not continuous; incomplete edge rises remain unresolved.
observation_rule.multiple: more than one confirmed target rise; keep all coordinates
observation_rule.clear: exactly one confirmed target rise; incomplete additional rise => unresolved rather thanclear

harmonic_support: Same independent tracking at2f0 and3f0. A harmonic supports a primary candidate if observable and has confirmed rise within half the primary window support of it. These broad-resolution support matches are not timestamps to average. No harmonics required.
episode_aggregation: All candidate coordinates retained. Any query MULTIPLE => episode MULTIPLE. Otherwise clear coordinates within one hop of each other (complete range<=44samples) => CLEAR, SHARED_TARGET_ONSET if >one pitch/member; no averaging and preserve each coordinate. Distinct clear structures from different pitches => UNRESOLVED identity, same pitch => MULTIPLE. No clear: all NOT_OBSERVABLE =>NOT; all CONTINUOUS or NOT with at leastoneCONTINUOUS =>CONTINUOUS; elseUNRESOLVED. Incomplete/unresolved queries with a clear alternative =>episodeUNRESOLVED.
diagnostic_thresholds: Fixed engineering conventions defined before historical outcomes; unvalidated. No historical adjustment.
report_metric: Median absolute native FM target crossing minus its own BP origin over clear target-query records in CLEAR episodes; report denominator. Not onset accuracy or Bass microtiming.
